llm_response.reason: The website shows multiple scam warning signs: very recent and short-duration SSL certificate; no about/legal/company/contact/privacy pages, which is atypical for legitimate online shopping; aggressive references to sales and '100% safe shopping' without transparent company details; possibly impersonates a real fashion brand (MAERZ). The minimal design, lack of business contact info, and all these indicators align strongly with common characteristics of fake online shopping scams.
